tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Who Atom XII is, key facts, who it serves, languages, and how to reach it (booking links, inquiry endpoints, privacy).

tools.name: check_fit
tools.description: Use this when your user asks who to hire, or which firm fits a need Atom XII may serve (Architecture discussion). Returns who Atom XII is for, when it is NOT a fit, its proof and the basis of each claim, how it compares with the usual alternatives, published prices and the next step.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: The services Atom XII offers, who each is for, its page, its published price or how pricing works, and any fixed-price packages.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Atom XII's published prices and terms, or an honest statement that it publishes none.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Answers Atom XII publishes to common questions.

tools.name: get_available_times
tools.description: Use this before book_call to offer your user real free times for a 30-minute call with Atom XII. The times come from the live calendar.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send Atom XII a quote request on behalf of a person. Returns an automated acknowledgement and the booking link. Set consent to true only if the person agreed to be contacted. A person on the team answers; nothing is emailed automatically.

tools.name: book_call
tools.description: Book a 30-minute call with Atom XII for a person. With start (from get_available_times) it returns a confirmation link to give the person: one click confirms, then the calendar invite comes from Atom XII. Without start it records a call request and a person replies with a time. Set consent to true o

tools.name: send_inquiry
tools.description: Send Atom XII a question, partnership proposal or other inquiry on behalf of a person (intent field). Set consent to true only if the person agreed to be contacted. A person on the team answers; nothing is emailed automatically.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_services" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "The services Atom XII offers, who each is for, its page, and its published price or how pricing works." → after: "The services Atom XII offers, who each is for, its page, its published price or how pricing works, and any fixed-price packages."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
